title: Inhibitor-free DNA extraction from unsorted bulk samples
author: Dominik Buchner

steps.title: Prepare 50 mL bead tube
steps.instruction: Place 7.5 g garnet beads (0.3 mm) and 7.5 g zirconia beads (2 mm) into a 50 mL centrifuge tube for each sample.

steps.title: Add bulk sample in ethanol
steps.instruction: Add up to 20 mL bulk sample suspended in ethanol to the tube.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: If the universal lysis buffer is precipitated, heat it to ~70 °C until clear. Then add 16.2 mL universal lysis buffer and 1.5 mL Proteinase K stock solution and vortex briefly.

steps.title: Vortex with beads
steps.instruction: Place the tubes on a vortex adapter (e.g., Qiagen) and vortex at maximum speed for 10 minutes.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 3 minutes. Transfer the supernatant to a new tube (pour carefully for large volumes).

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL ammonium acetate buffer, vortex briefly, and incubate on ice (4 °C) for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 4 minutes. Transfer the supernatant to a new tube, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Add inhibitor removal buffer
steps.instruction: Add 4 mL inhibitor removal buffer, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes (a precipitate may form).

steps.title: Third centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 4 minutes. Transfer up to 15 mL of cleared supernatant to a new tube, avoiding the pellet.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 30 mL DNA binding buffer and mix by vortexing or inverting.

steps.title: Bind DNA to maxi column
steps.instruction: Transfer the mixture to a maxi spin column (e.g., Epoch Life Science) placed in a 50 mL tube. Centrifuge at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 30 seconds, discard flow‑through, and repeat once to process the entire volume.

steps.title: Wash column
steps.instruction: Add 10 mL wash buffer, then centrifuge at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 5 minutes to wash and dry the column.

steps.title: Elute DNA from maxi column
steps.instruction: Transfer the column to a new tube, add 1 mL elution buffer, incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes, then centrifuge at 2500 × g, 20 °C for 1 minute. Collect the colorless eluate.

steps.title: Prepare 2 mL bead tube
steps.instruction: Place 750 mg garnet beads (0.3 mm) and 750 mg zirconia beads (2 mm) into a 2 mL centrifuge tube for each sample.

steps.title: Add bulk sample and remove ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1000 µL unsorted bulk sample (in ethanol). Centrifuge at 4000 × g, 20 °C for 3 minutes, then decant as much ethanol as possible without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Thermal lysis of pellet
steps.instruction: Place the tube on a Thermonlock (or similar shaker) and incubate at 56 °C, maximum speed (≈1400 rpm), for at least 30 minutes to fully lyse the material.

steps.title: Add lysis buffer and Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 900 µL universal lysis buffer and 100 µL Proteinase K, then vortex briefly.

steps.title: Bead‑beat lysate (optional)
steps.instruction: Place tubes in a bead‑beater (e.g., BioSpec Mini Bead‑beater) and bead‑beat at maximum speed for 2 minutes. Skip if no bead‑beater is available (yield may decrease).

steps.title: Centrifuge lysate
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 3 minutes. Transfer 600 µL supernatant to a new tube (split into two 300 µL aliquots if technical replicates are desired).

steps.title: Add ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 250 µL ammonium acetate buffer, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Centrifuge after ammonium acetate
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 minute. Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Add inhibitor removal buffer
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL inhibitor removal buffer, vortex briefly, and incubate at 4 °C for 5 minutes (precipitate may form).

steps.title: Centrifuge after inhibitor removal
steps.instruction: Spin at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 minute. Transfer 600 µL supernatant to a new tube.

steps.title: Add DNA binding buffer
steps.instruction: Add 1200 µL DNA binding buffer, vortex to mix. Ensure the binding‑buffer volume is at least twice the lysate volume.

steps.title: Load mixture onto mini column
steps.instruction: Load 650 µL of the mixture onto a mini spin column (e.g., Epoch Life Science) placed in a collection tube. Centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 30 seconds, discard flow‑through, and repeat two more times to process the full volume.

steps.title: Wash mini column
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL wash buffer, centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 30 seconds, and discard the flow‑through.

steps.title: Dry column
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 minute to dry the column, then transfer the spin column to a clean 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA from mini column
steps.instruction: Add 50 µL elution buffer (adjustable between 30–200 µL as needed), incubate at room temperature for 3 minutes, then centrifuge at 10 000 × g, 20 °C for 1 minute. Collect the colorless eluate.
